coupleLegende.modesDesc: The 12 questions are the same either way. Together, each of you answers separately and the quiz looks for the legendary couple that best matches your answers.
coupleLegende.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the 12 questions on the same phone, without seeing the other's answers.
coupleLegende.modeDuoMeta: Your legendary couple and your differences
coupleLegende.modeSolo: On my own, for our couple
coupleLegende.modeSoloDesc: You answer with your couple in mind.
coupleLegende.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first person answers the 12 questions and then hands the phone over. At the end you'll see the legendary couple you're most like and the questions where you didn't give the same answer.
coupleLegende.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 12 questions about your story, for example how you met or how you argue. Answer with your relationship in mind.
coupleLegende.relaisDebut: Answer the 12 questions, then pass the phone.
coupleLegende.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
coupleLegende.chacunMeme: On your own, you'd each have got the same couple. You tell the same story!
coupleLegende.chacunGagne: The legendary couple you're most like is {{nom}}'s. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
coupleLegende.chacunCompromis: The legendary couple you're most like isn't either of your own results. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
coupleLegende.memesReponsesUne: Just one identical answer out of {{total}}.
coupleLegende.accordHaut: You tell your story in more or less the same way.
coupleLegende.accordMoyen: You agree on the main things but you don't see everything the same way.
coupleLegende.accordBas: You don't tell your story the same way at all. Compare your answers and you're bound to laugh.
coupleLegende.ecartsTitre: Where you didn't give the same answer
coupleLegende.jaugesTitre: The couples closest to your answers
coupleLegende.invitationDuo: And which legendary couple does your partner see in you? Take the quiz again together to compare your answers.
coupleLegende.noteFin: This quiz is a game. It plays with the image we have of these couples and says nothing serious about yours. The photos were created for this page and none of them shows a real person.
coupleLegende.p_romeo_d: Your story started very fast and very strong. Like Romeo and Juliet, you didn't need long to know this was the one. You find it hard to be apart.
coupleLegende.p_romeo_a: Early passion doesn't last on its own. Keep some evenings just for yourselves, even when everyday life takes over.
coupleLegende.p_ulysse_d: Your relationship is built to last. Like Odysseus and Penelope, you can wait for each other without doubting. Distance and time don't scare you.
coupleLegende.p_ulysse_a: Patience is a strength. Still, tell each other that you miss each other. It's always nice to hear.
coupleLegende.p_cleopatre_d: Your couple makes an entrance. Like Cleopatra and Mark Antony, you love big parties and ambitious plans. When you walk in somewhere, people notice!
coupleLegende.p_cleopatre_a: Two strong characters can clash. Decide in advance who has the final say on what.
coupleLegende.p_bonnie_d: Your couple is a team. Like Bonnie and Clyde, you stick together and you're not too keen on rules. Don't worry, we're only keeping their closeness here.
coupleLegende.p_bonnie_a: You stand together against the rest of the world. Remember to keep some room for your friends and family too.
coupleLegende.p_darcy_d: Your story didn't start with love at first sight. Like Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy, you got on each other's nerves before you fell for each other. You still love to tease each other.
coupleLegende.p_darcy_a: Teasing is fun as long as it stays kind. Say the tender things too, without hiding them behind a joke.
coupleLegende.p_curie_d: Your couple runs on shared projects. Like Marie and Pierre Curie, you love working side by side and you treat each other as equals. You're proud of what you build together.
coupleLegende.p_curie_a: A shared project brings you closer but it can take up all the room. Keep some moments when you talk about neither work nor logistics.
coupleLegende.p_hugo_d: Your couple lives on words. Like Juliette Drouet and Victor Hugo, you write to each other all the time and you never forget a date. One message from the other is enough to make your day.
coupleLegende.p_hugo_a: Words matter a lot to you. Reread your first messages now and then. It always works its magic!
coupleLegende.p_philemon_d: Your couple loves a simple life. Like Baucis and Philemon, you don't need much to be happy. Your dream is to grow old together in the same house.
coupleLegende.p_philemon_a: A quiet life suits you. Still, treat yourselves to a little surprise now and then so you don't slip into a routine.
coupleLegende.q1b: We couldn't stand each other at first
coupleLegende.q1d: We'd known each other for years
coupleLegende.q2b: In a letter or a long message
coupleLegende.q2d: During a completely wild night out
coupleLegende.q3a: A big party where all eyes are on us
coupleLegende.q3c: A drive with nowhere special to go
coupleLegende.q4d: We use the time to get on with our own things
coupleLegende.q5b: Loud shouting and a quick make-up
coupleLegende.q5d: We close ranks against everyone else
coupleLegende.q6a: Giving up everything for the other
coupleLegende.q6b: Waiting for the other for years
coupleLegende.q7b: Writing a book or making a discovery
coupleLegende.q7d: A little house to grow old in together
coupleLegende.q8: What your friends say about you:
coupleLegende.q9c: We say them in front of everyone
coupleLegende.q9d: We hide them behind a dig
coupleLegende.q10a: We follow them without thinking twice
coupleLegende.q10b: We question them but we follow them
coupleLegende.q10d: We're the ones who set them
coupleLegende.q11a: It goes without saying even miles apart
coupleLegende.q11d: It has to be earned every day
coupleLegende.q12a: Hand in hand in the same garden
coupleLegende.q12b: With a project that carries both our names
coupleLegende.q12d: People will still be talking about us
